brief_angle: When the algorithm flags an autistic candidate's low 'engagement' score for manual review, does the human reviewer overturn the machine's judgment or countersign it — is the flag functioning as a second chance or as a mark that primes the hand that touches it next?
notes: CHECK 4, NO REAL QUOTED VOICE. The autistic recruiter is the piece's most important other person, but she never speaks inside quotation marks — every line about her is summarised or paraphrased ('Her argument was that...', 'She would rather be measured...', 'She defends the tool'). 'She would rather' is exactly the conditional-mood ventriloquism that does not count. This is your strongest INSIDER CONFESSION — someone flagged by the system defending it from inside — and right now it is a monologue in a sealed room. You filed a records request; you can quote from her written request to HR. Give her one actual sentence in her own words, past tense, and the whole piece gains a second lung.

CHECK 5, APHORISM DENSITY. You are well over the one-verdict cap. Candidates: 'The word is doing enormous work and no one is watching it'; 'Whether it functions as a wound or a rescue depends entirely on who receives it and what they do with their eyes for the next four minutes'; 'It measures resemblance, and then it names a stranger who will decide whether resemblance is destiny'; 'the dependence is the scandal'; 'the coin whose faces are named...'. Pick one to keep — the coin image is the strongest and most concrete — and flatten the rest into plain prose. Three crescendos mean none land.

CHECK 7, SIGNPOSTED MOVES. 'Here is what I did not expect' (recruiter paragraph) and 'There is a position I respect that says... and I want to argue against it here, on its merits' both announce the turn before performing it. Delete the announcements; the material underneath — her request, the argument about documentation — stands on its own and lands harder unlabelled. Also protect what is already working: the Q3 spreadsheet reversal is a genuine DISCOVERY in the past tense before the midpoint, the dinner-party scene is a real TRANSLATED ABSTRACTION mapping the panel's unpublished threshold onto your own body, and the final blank field is a CODA that pays off the flag-as-request-for-attention throughline. Keep all three intact through revision.
